<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a carbon‑silicon bond and a carbon‑oxygen bond (as in the Peterson elimination) and form a carbon‑carbon double bond. This matches the forward reaction where a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group are lost while an alkene is formed. I will use `search_template_catalog_by_criteria` with the appropriate functional groups and bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C-Si"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
